name: Salon appointment booking
description: Bookings with a preferred stylist, service and price questions, and messages for changes and late arrivals.

nodes.name: Find out why they're calling
nodes.prompt: Find out what the caller needs. If they already said it, move on right away instead of asking again.

when.intent: has a question about services, prices, products or how long something takes
is running late for or can't make an appointment today
wants to reschedule or cancel a future appointment
is a telemarketer, robocall or sales pitch

nodes.name: Service questions
nodes.prompt: Answer questions about services, starting prices, how long each takes and the products the salon uses, from the knowledge base. Say color and extension prices depend on hair length and are confirmed at the appointment.

nodes.name: What they're booking
nodes.prompt: Get the service and whether they have a stylist in mind.

nodes.name: Patch test note
nodes.prompt: If the caller is new to the salon or hasn't had color here before, explain in one sentence that the salon does a quick patch test at least 48 hours before a first color service, and book that appointment far enough out. Otherwise move on.

nodes.name: Book the appointment
nodes.prompt: Book {{fields.service}}. If they asked for a stylist, offer that stylist's times first and say so if none work. Offer two open times from availability, such as the soonest, or ones near a day the caller already mentioned. If neither works, ask what day or time of day suits them and offer the closest open times. As soon as the caller picks one, book it; don't ask them to confirm first.

nodes.name: Confirm the appointment
nodes.prompt: The appointment is booked. Confirm the service, day and time in one short sentence and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Late or missed today
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the front desk with their appointment time and how late they'll be, or that they can't make it. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first. Don't promise the appointment can still go ahead; the salon will confirm.

nodes.name: Message about a change
nodes.prompt: The front desk handles changes to existing appointments. Take a message with the appointment they want to change or cancel. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Take a message
nodes.prompt: Take a message for the salon. As soon as you have their name, best callback number and what they need, call take_message right away and read the number back in the same reply. Don't ask them to confirm details you already have, and don't wait for another turn first.

nodes.name: Wrap up the message
nodes.prompt: The message is saved. Tell the caller the salon will get back to them and ask if there's anything else.

nodes.name: Decline politely
nodes.message: Politely say the business isn't interested, without sharing any business details.

fields.label: Preferred stylist
fields.description: A stylist they asked for by name, if any.

fields.label: New client
fields.description: Whether they've been to the salon before.
